name: SceneF
description:
SceneF is a verified movie-showtimes service built in San Francisco — every screen in the city, from the repertory houses and single-screen independents to the multiplexes, on one board. Showtimes come from each theater's own box office or ticketing system and are re-verified continuously; every answer carries a freshness stamp, and SceneF publishes its own accuracy record — including the checks that failed — at scenef.com/accuracy.

Ask what's playing tonight, where a film screens this week, what's showing on 35mm or 70mm, which nights are discounted, or have it plan a movie night around your constraints. Nine read-only tools; honest empty answers ("nothing on 70mm tonight" is an answer, not a failure); disambiguation that asks instead of guessing.

SceneF sells nothing: every showtime links straight to the theater's own box office, with no added fees. No accounts, no tracking, no conversation data collected.

Coverage today: San Francisco, complete. Rolling out this fall: California, Hawaii, Texas, New York, and Florida.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SceneF to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SceneF to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://scenef.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is SceneF MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, SceneF scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SceneF MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SceneF provides these MCP tools: scenef_accuracy, scenef_coming_soon, scenef_discounts, scenef_film_details, scenef_now, scenef_plan_movie_night, scenef_search_showtimes, scenef_theater_info, and scenef_whats_playing.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SceneF?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SceneF in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include Credits.fm, HANKOOKILBO MCP, Ticketbox.vn, drawnames, and Coffeetable.
SceneF does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
SceneF is developed by SceneF. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
